goal: Prevent JSON-RPC batch error responses from inheriting the preceding request's ID or notification status
Ensure clients sending malformed items in a batch receive proper error replies instead of dropped responses
agreement: Strong support with all reviewer suggestions resolved
Fixes JSON-RPC 2.0 spec compliance for clients expecting distinct IDs in batch replies (pinheadmz)
Verified bug fix and test coverage through functional testing (janb84, pinheadmz)
Approved after author adopted the suggested fresh-request design (hodlinator)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it fixes an edge-case JSON-RPC 2.0 compliance bug for malformed batch requests
Only affects batches containing non-object elements, making the fix low-severity and deferrable
